nodes.label: Craft Cocktails Display — Three vibrant signature cocktails on a wood-grain bar table in a moody restaurant setting: a spicy-rimmed orange citrus margarita with chili salt rim and orange wedge garnish (foreground), a pale yellow coupe-glass cocktail likely a daiquiri or sour (center), and a teal blue rocks drink (background right). Exposed brick wall and colorful abstract street-art painting create an eclectic, urban-chic atmosphere. Presentation is Instagram-worthy and curated to convey a creative craft bar program on the restaurant website.
